basis: Defined by a complex neurodevelopmental disorder; no specific additional organ damage is established.
Cardiac repolarization disorder with prolonged QTc in 15/15; these data do not establish multisystem Timothy syndrome.
Focal malformation of cerebral cortical architecture.
Complement immunodeficiency; recurrent infections and predisposition to separately diagnosed renal or rheumatic diseases do not establish additional direct organ damage.
Complex spastic paraplegia; cataracts and hearing impairment each occur in 30-79%.
Tumor originates in the stomach; neuroendocrine differentiation alone does not establish endocrine gland disease.
Early-onset epilepsy with frequent developmental delay and intellectual disability.
Ovarian epithelial malignancy has a reproductive origin; mucinous morphology does not establish gastrointestinal origin or endocrine dysfunction.
Dysplastic glandular neoplasm arising in rectal mucosa.
Persistent congenital vascular tumor of skin/subcutis; heart failure, thrombocytopenia and hepatic lesions are each only 5-29%.
Regression 1/2, muscle pathology 1/2 and severe visual loss 1/1 support involvement; cardiac hypertrophy and gastroparesis (1/1 each) omitted by cap.
Renal tubulointerstitial disease with kidney failure in 3/3; retinal degeneration in 1/3 meets the approximate 30% threshold. Anemia is secondary to kidney disease.
Hair, sweat-gland and dental abnormalities define disease; salivary dysfunction also occurs. Rhinitis and recurrent infections do not establish lasting pulmonary damage.
Inherited bile-salt transport disorder causing recurrent intrahepatic cholestasis; pruritus alone does not establish skin damage.
Inherited heme-synthesis defect causing sideroblastic anemia; hepatic abnormalities and glucose intolerance are only 5-29%; weakness alone is not myopathy.
Kidney, cardiac and skeletal abnormalities each reported in 80-99%; external-ear dysmorphism lacks demonstrated functional damage.
Cytopenias, myelitis/chorea and cutaneous lupus each reported in 1/3; arthralgia alone is insufficient. Oral ulcers and optic neuritis (1/3 each) omitted by cap.
Inherited progressive cerebral neurodegeneration causing dementia; behavioral and motor manifestations belong to neurologic disease.
Distal skeletal myopathy with defining laryngeal/pharyngeal weakness; these structures belong to pulmonary. ALS is a distinct diagnosis, not automatic nerve involvement.
Myopathic mitochondrial nucleotide disorder; encephalopathy and seizures reported in 30-79%. Respiratory failure reflects muscle weakness rather than intrinsic lung damage.
Ovarian inflammation is generally infectious; reproductive location has no axis, and endocrine dysfunction is not established.
Astrocytic neoplasm arising in the central nervous system.
Middle-ear disease with sterile serous effusion; infection or an immune mechanism is not inherent to this umbrella concept.
Developmental hypoplasia of the pituitary endocrine gland; its intracranial location does not establish neurologic damage.
Locally aggressive adipocytic soft-tissue tumor, typically in deep extremity connective tissue; superficial variants do not establish common skin involvement.
